## Purpose and entry points
`gh-aw` is a GitHub CLI extension that compiles Markdown agent specifications (YAML frontmatter plus prompt body) into executable GitHub Actions workflows. Primary binaries are the native CLI at `cmd/gh-aw/main.go`, the browser/WASM compiler at `cmd/gh-aw-wasm/main.go`, and custom-linter runner at `cmd/linters/main.go`. The primary application layer is Go; generated workflow runtime helpers are Node/CommonJS and shell.

## Source parsing and composition
The parser turns workflow Markdown into typed configuration, validates embedded schemas, resolves local/remote imports, expands includes, and processes inline agents/skills. This is the boundary from author-controlled declarative source to an internal workflow model. Key paths: `pkg/parser/frontmatter.go`, `pkg/parser/import_processor.go`, `pkg/parser/schema_validation.go`.

## Compilation pipeline
CLI commands orchestrate discovery, compilation, validation, post-processing, and writing `.lock.yml` GitHub Actions artifacts. The compiler constructs triggers, jobs, expressions, checkout/setup, engine execution, artifacts, and generated YAML; it also manages pinned Actions/container references. Key paths: `pkg/cli/compile_pipeline.go`, `pkg/workflow/compiler.go`, `pkg/workflow/compiler_yaml.go`.

## Execution model and engines
Compiled workflows execute on GitHub Actions runners. Agent engines are adapter-based and include Copilot, Claude, Codex, Gemini, Pi, plus behavior-defined/custom engines. Engine-specific compilation emits install/configuration, prompt execution, tool wiring, log collection, and retry behavior. Key paths: `pkg/workflow/engine.go`, `pkg/workflow/copilot_engine.go`, `pkg/workflow/claude_engine.go`.

## Security boundaries
Agent jobs are designed to be sandboxed and read-only by default. Compilation enforces permissions, token/secret handling, expression and template-injection controls, checkout constraints, network/domain policy, and optional sandbox runtimes. GitHub writes cross a separate safe-output boundary rather than being performed directly by agents. Key paths: `pkg/workflow/sandbox.go`, `pkg/workflow/permissions.go`, `pkg/workflow/firewall.go`.

## Safe outputs and external mutations
Agents emit structured proposed actions; a separate scoped job validates, stages, and dispatches them to GitHub entities or supported work trackers. The Node runtime implements the executable handler registry and validates manifests/types before API calls. Supported integrations visibly include GitHub, Jira, Linear, and Azure DevOps. Key paths: `pkg/workflow/safe_outputs_handler_registry.go`, `pkg/workflow/compiler_safe_outputs_job.go`, `actions/setup/js/safe_output_processor.cjs`.

## MCP and runtime services
The compiler configures MCP servers/tools and can generate gateway, safe-output, and script-server setup. Runtime scripts start local services and route agent tool traffic through MCP Gateway; companion firewall/proxy services constrain network access. Key paths: `pkg/workflow/mcp_setup_generator.go`, `pkg/workflow/mcp_gateway_config.go`, `actions/setup/sh/start_mcp_gateway.sh`.

## Operations, telemetry, and distribution
The CLI supports workflow lifecycle operations plus log/audit/forecast/outcome analysis. Generated runs collect engine, firewall, MCP, safe-output, evaluation, and token/AI-credit data, with OTLP export support. A WASM build powers documentation-side compilation; Astro serves the documentation site. Key paths: `pkg/cli/logs_orchestrator.go`, `pkg/cli/audit_run_pipeline.go`, `pkg/workflow/observability_otlp.go`.
